claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AW IMR 14500 650mAh 9A as a 650mAh preset with a 9A runtime rating.
The AW IMR 14500 650mAh entry is listed as an unprotected button-top cell in an aggregated battery test database.

The AW IMR 14500 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry AW IMR 14500 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2012-09-16 or earlier.
